name: Futanari Affairs
source: Emily is young, beautiful and very sexy. She finds herself in enthralled by the seductive gaze of Angel, a woman who likes to take control, and who has more to offer Emily than any man ever could. Her innocent gaze dipping lower, Emily finally sees what’s really in store for her! All shyness aside, she knows now this is what she really wanted all along.
translation: 艾米丽年轻、美丽、非常性感。她发现自己被安吉尔诱人的目光迷住了，安吉尔是一个喜欢掌控一切的女人，并且比任何男人都能为艾米丽提供更多。艾米丽无辜的目光低垂下来，终于看到了等待她的是什么！撇开害羞不谈，她现在知道这就是她一直以来真正想要的。
